mapper.select: SELECT setting_key AS "settingKey", setting_name AS "settingName", setting_value AS "settingValue", value_type AS "valueType", unit_code AS "unitCode", scope_type AS "scopeType", display_order AS "displayOrder" FROM system_common_setting WHERE scope_type = 'GLOBAL' AND use_yn = 'Y' AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY display_order, setting_key
mapper.update: UPDATE system_common_setting SET setting_value = #{settingValue}, change_reason = #{changeReason}, updated_at = now() WHERE setting_key = #{settingKey} AND scope_type = 'GLOBAL' AND use_yn = 'Y' AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM system_common_setting WHERE scope_type <> 'GLOBAL'
SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'system_common_setting' AND column_name IN ('user_id', 'business_category')
SELECT count(*) FROM change_history WHERE entity_name = #{entityName}
